subject: general
question: Under which Article of the Constitution of India do we consider Hindi in Devanagari script as an official language of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 343**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 343**

 
 
• Article 343 (1) of the Constitution, states that the official language of the Union shall be Hindi in Devanagari script.
 
• Hindi written in Dev
